answer: An agent market can require a separate 200-token escrow for each identity allowed to bid; zephyr, prism, and timber cannot share one deposit. Requesting withdrawal immediately disables that identity and holds its escrow for 30 days, preventing an attacker from rapidly recycling funds through fresh aliases. Each extra active identity requires 200 more tokens of capital. At an assumed 1% monthly financing rate, that costs 2 tokens per month, plus 2 tokens for the exit delay.
